4683 - LED Wall Infrastructure - Oregon Convention Center

Project #: 4683 (ITB)
Issued by: Oregon Metro
[open agency website in new window ]
Publish Date: Nov 17, 2026 2:19PM
Bids Due Date: Dec 8, 2026 2:00PM (Pacific Standard Time) add to calendar

save to watchlist express interest

Description

Metro, acting by and through the appointed Metropolitan Exposition Recreation Commission (MERC), is inviting bids for LED Wall Infrastructure for the Oregon Convention Center. Sealed bids must be enclosed in a sealed envelope and mailed or delivered to Metro, 600 NE Grand Avenue, Portland, Oregon 97232-2736, no later than the date and time indicated on the ITB cover page and will be publicly opened and read at that time in Room 279.  

The project consists of furnishing and installing the complete infrastructure necessary to support two large-format LED video wall systems within the pre-function areas at the Oregon Convention Center. Work includes but is not limited to electrical power distribution, low-voltage/data systems, structural reinforcement, wall modifications, fire alarm device relocation, and associated architectural finishes required to support a fully operational digital signage installation.

Pre-Bid Site Visit Information

A voluntary Pre-Bid Conference is scheduled for all potential prime and sub-contractors on December 1, 2026, at 8:30  a.m. at the Oregon Convention Center, 777 NE Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Portland, OR 97232.

·      Please RSVP through BidLocker by 2:00 pm on November 30, 2026.

·      All contractors that RSVP will receive a parking pass which will give access to the P2 parking garage located in the back of the building off NE 1st Ave (P2 PARKING GARAGE).

·    We will meet in the MLK Lobby (Main Entrance) located on NE Martin Luther King Jr Blvd and NE Oregon St (MLK LOBBY).
